**Glasgow Mathematical Journal (2026), 1–10 RESEARCH ARTICLE**

*Generalised Markov traces and Jucys–Murphy elements*

10 pp, 7 sections.

**Abstract.** We give a simple construction of Markov traces for Iwahori–Hecke algebras associated with the crystallographic Coxeter groups of types An, Bn and Dn.I nt y p e sB and D, it is new and generalises a known construction in typeA employing symmetric polynomials in multiplicative Jucys–Murphy elements.

**Outline.** Iwahori-Hecke algebras; Coxeter groups; Introduction; Some central elements in the classical Iwahori; Markov traces; General Markov traces in types B, D; Geometric Markov traces
